confidence_notes: Food, coffee, and beer estimates use Hoi An cost-of-living price-index levels, with limited and variable local samples. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated as several times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Hoi An price data directly for food and drink; no comparable city was substituted. Accommodation estimates reflect Hoi An’s tourist-town context.
